errors.text_span: The chart features four groups of bars, each representing a different SFT configuration: no SFT (blue), + SFT on D0 (yellow), + SFT on D0, D1 (purple), and + SFT on D0, D1, D2 (red). For each model variant, the bars are arranged in ascending order of SFT configurations.
errors.evidence: The bars are stacked, not grouped. The machine-generated description incorrectly describes the bars as grouped rather than stacked.

errors.text_span: 87% for LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B with + SFT on D0, D1, D2
errors.evidence: The figure shows the red bar (+ SFT on D0, D1, D2) for LLaMA-2-13B at approximately 80% and for LLaMA-2-70B at close to 80%, not 87%.
The figure shows the blue bar (no SFT) for LLaMA-2-7B at approximately 66%, not 65%.

errors.text_span: no SFT (blue), + SFT on D0 (yellow), + SFT on D0, D1 (purple), and + SFT on D0, D1, D2 (red)
errors.evidence: The description omits the pattern details: 'no SFT' has white diagonal stripes, '+ SFT on D0' has white horizontal stripes, and '+ SFT on D0, D1' has slanted stripes. The red bar is correctly described as solid fill.
The description does not mention that the bars are visually emphasized with distinct color patterns for each category.

errors.text_span: The bar chart illustrates the effect of scaling up model scales and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) datasets on the performance of LLaMA-2 models, specifically measuring the CoLeG-R percentage.
errors.evidence: The description introduces interpretation ('effect of scaling up model scales and SFT datasets') not explicitly shown in the figure. The figure only shows CoLeG-R percentages under different conditions.

errors.text_span: The approximate CoLeG-R percentages for the shortest and tallest bars are 65% for LLaMA-2-7B with no SFT and 87% for LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B with + SFT on D0, D1, D2.
errors.evidence: The description oversimplifies by only mentioning the shortest and tallest bars, ignoring the intermediate values and their relative differences.
